description.rendered: ings of Kings International brings its 31st Anniversary Celebration to Montréal on Friday, May 29, 2026, for a night of authentic reggae and sound system culture. Taking place at The Caribbean Food Factory, this high-energy event features international DJs Tony Matterhorn and Iley Dread alongside the legendary Stone Love, delivering the true Kingston vibe live. The night also includes a special live performance and album launch by Iley Dread, with additional guest appearances, top Montréal DJs, and hosting by Richie B with live broadcast coverage. With tiered ticket pricing and a full lineup of talent, this event sets the tone for an unforgettable weekend of reggae celebration across Canada.
